resolution: Committed roads now render from the shared filleted transport path as smooth analytic asphalt and sidewalk ribbons while the one-metre stamp remains authoritative for vehicle flow, junctions, undo, and persistence. Exact tile/material undercoat restoration removes stair-step protrusions, lane paint keeps continuous path distance across bends and chunk boundaries, and bounded overflow falls back loudly to the complete raster. Native and formula suites plus the ReleaseFast editor build pass; visual bend quality and the required 60-second spikewatch remain for user verification.
